columns.name: store_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the store.

columns.name: store_name
columns.description: Name of the store.

columns.name: state
columns.description: State where the store is located.

columns.name: least_quantity_sale_title
columns.description: The title of the book with the least quantity sold in the store, with ties broken by the ascending order of the title.

columns.name: total_sales_quantity
columns.description: Total quantity of books sold in the store, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_of_Net_30_payment
columns.description: the percentage of the quantity ordered that were on 'Net 30' payment terms

columns.name: percentage_of_psychology
columns.description: The percentage of psychology book sold by the store

columns.name: title_has_highest_ytd_sales
columns.description: The title of the book in the store that has the highest year-to-date sales, with ties broken by the ascending order of the title.

columns.name: pub_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the publisher.

columns.name: pub_name
columns.description: Name of the publisher.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country where the publisher is located.

columns.name: number_of_titles_1991
columns.description: Number of titles published by the publisher in 1991, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: most_expensive_book
columns.description: The title of the most expensive book published by the publisher, with ties broken by the ascending order of the title.

columns.name: book_has_the_highest_royalty
columns.description: The title of the book with the highest royalty published by the publisher, with ties broken by the descending order of the title.

columns.name: average_ytd_sales
columns.description: Average year-to-date sales of the books published by the publisher.

columns.name: most_ytd_sale_title
columns.description: The title of the book with the most year-to-date sales published by the publisher, with ties broken by the ascending order of the title.

columns.name: title_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the title.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title of the book.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Type of the title.

columns.name: has_ytd_sales_higher_than_average
columns.description: Set to 1 if the year-to-date sales of the title are higher than the average year-to-date sales of all titles; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: has_above_average_royalty_rate
columns.description: Set to 1 if the royalty rate of the title is above the average royalty rate of all titles; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: sold_more_than_average
columns.description: Set to 1 if the title has sold more copies than the average number of copies sold by all titles; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: number_of_sales_in_California_stores
columns.description: Number of copies sold in stores located in California, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: ordered_quantity_1992
columns.description: Quantity of the title ordered in 1992, replace NULL values with 0.
